verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a prebuilt n8n, Zapier, or other no-code automation connector. Riveter documents an MCP connector for AI assistants like Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor, plus webhook_url callbacks and SDKs, but these are an adjacent feature and developer building blocks, not a prebuilt no-code automation connector.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect the scraping API to no-code automation platforms like n8n or Zapier through a prebuilt connector
